mapper.select: select (select count(1) from erp_sales_order where del_flag = '0') as salesOrderCount, (select ifnull(sum(amount_tax), 0) from erp_sales_order where del_flag = '0') as salesAmount, (select count(1) from erp_purchase_order where del_flag = '0') as purchaseOrderCount, (select ifnull(sum(amount_tax), 0) from erp_purchase_order where del_flag = '0') as purchaseAmount, (select ifnull(sum(stock_qty), 0) from erp_inventory) as inventoryQty, (select ifnull(sum(stock_qty * cost_price), 0) from erp_inventory) as inventoryAmount, (select count(1) from erp_production_order where del_flag = '0') as productionOrderCount, (select ifnull(sum(amount - settled_amount), 0) from erp_receivable where del_flag = '0') as arAmount, (select ifnull(sum(amount - settled_amount), 0) from erp_payable where del_flag = '0') as apAmount

select o.order_code as orderCode, c.customer_name as customerName, o.order_date as orderDate, o.delivery_date as deliveryDate, o.amount_tax as amountTax, o.status as status, (select ifnull(sum(l.qty), 0) from erp_sales_order_line l where l.order_id = o.order_id) as orderQty, (select ifnull(sum(l.delivered_qty), 0) from erp_sales_order_line l where l.order_id = o.order_id) as deliveredQty from erp_sales_order o left join erp_customer c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id where o.del_flag = '0' and o.customer_id = #{customerId} and o.status = #{status} order by o.order_date desc

select m.material_code as materialCode, m.material_name as materialName, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, i.batch_no as batchNo, i.stock_qty as stockQty, i.cost_price as costPrice, (i.stock_qty * i.cost_price) as amount, timestampdiff(day, ifnull(i.create_time, now()), now()) as ageDays from erp_inventory i left join erp_material m on m.material_id = i.material_id left join erp_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id where i.stock_qty > 0 and i.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} order by ageDays desc

select s.supplier_code as supplierCode, s.supplier_name as supplierName, count(1) as poCount, sum(case when p.status in ('3','4') and p.delivery_date >= now() then 1 else 0 end) as onTimeCount, sum(case when p.status not in ('3','4') and p.delivery_date < now() then 1 else 0 end) as delayCount from erp_purchase_order p left join erp_supplier s on s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id where p.del_flag = '0' group by s.supplier_id, s.supplier_code, s.supplier_name order by poCount desc

select mo.mo_code as moCode, m.material_name as productName, mo.plan_qty as planQty, mo.finish_qty as finishQty, case when mo.plan_qty > 0 then round(mo.finish_qty / mo.plan_qty * 100, 2) else 0 end as achieveRate, mo.status as status, mo.plan_end_date as planEndDate from erp_production_order mo left join erp_material m on m.material_id = mo.material_id where mo.del_flag = '0' and mo.status = #{status} order by mo.plan_end_date desc
